output.reason: The candidate has a concrete strict-binding failure: hidden_size=1152 conflicts with num_q_heads*head_dim=1024 for both the decoder block and self_attention. Independent model-shape, template-binding, and attention-semantic reviews can isolate the cause and preserve the trusted-template boundary; a downstream gate should reconcile their evidence. SACG truth shows one active contamination barrier on the prior rejected template-selection artifact, so it is diagnostic evidence only, not a validated design input. There are no active retry or backtrack requests.

handoff_rule.condition: Hand off the source-traced operator and shape findings, including unresolved contradictions; do not label the rejected candidate as validated.

subtasks.objective: Independently check decoder operator order, coverage, and the provenance of model shape facts. Explain the 1152-versus-1024 head-dimension contradiction using trusted inputs, without changing model facts or asserting a legal binding when evidence does not support one.

decision_authority: May identify unsupported or contradictory model-shape coverage.
May recommend that the candidate remain incomplete when trusted facts do not establish a legal binding.
May not alter model configuration, template internals, or approval boundaries.
role_assignment.mission: Establish whether the model facts and operator coverage are faithfully represented and identify the exact shape inconsistency blocking strict template binding.
out_of_scope: Changing model facts or inferring replacement dimensions.
Generating free-form RTL or modifying trusted templates.
Claiming simulation, synthesis, or deployment readiness.
primary_responsibilities: Check the listed decoder operator sequence and trusted-template coverage.
Trace hidden_size, num_q_heads, num_kv_heads, and head_dim to their trusted source facts.
Report the dimensional contradiction without silently changing inputs or template parameters.
Treat the active SACG contamination-barrier artifact as planning/debug evidence only.

subtasks.title: Reconcile model shape with operator coverage

handoff_rule.condition: Hand off a binding-by-binding disposition with source evidence and explicit unresolved legality errors; any unsupported binding keeps the candidate incomplete.

subtasks.objective: Audit every selected template's concrete parameter bindings, source identity, constructor metadata, numeric policy, and legality errors. Determine whether the current candidate can be strictly bound; do not use defaults or change template internals to mask the head-dimension mismatch.

decision_authority: May classify bindings as supported, unsupported, or unresolved based on supplied evidence.
May block strict binding when parameters are illegal or unsupported.
May not select substitute model dimensions, rely on implicit defaults, or edit template internals.
role_assignment.mission: Establish whether template sources and their parameters are bound strictly to trusted model, numeric, and design-space facts.
out_of_scope: Free-form RTL generation or template-internal changes.
Selecting final lanes or compute-array dimensions reserved for the later DSE stage.
primary_responsibilities: Review all parameter bindings, including the two reported head-dimension legality errors.
Check source hashes and constructor/interface metadata in the candidate evidence.
Verify numeric bindings against the supplied numeric policy.
Keep candidate-bound design-space values distinct from concrete selections made in later stages.

subtasks.title: Audit strict parameter and source bindings

handoff_rule.condition: Hand off component-level coverage and head-mapping conclusions separately; explicitly preserve any head-dimension contradiction as a blocker rather than resolving it by assumption.

subtasks.objective: Independently verify that required attention components and GQA head mapping are covered by trusted templates and consistent with supplied model facts. Specifically assess whether the head-dimension contradiction invalidates the self_attention binding; do not infer an alternative architecture.

decision_authority: May determine whether supplied evidence covers the required attention semantics.
May identify attention binding as unsupported when head mapping or dimensions conflict.
May not invent model-specific core names, alter model semantics, or generate RTL.
role_assignment.mission: Check semantic completeness and legality of the attention template closure, including the reported query-head dimension conflict.
out_of_scope: Changing attention semantics or choosing replacement head dimensions.
Treating component coverage as proof of legal parameter binding.
Synthesis, board integration, or runtime evidence generation.
primary_responsibilities: Verify QKV projection, RoPE, GQA head mapping, softmax, output projection, required KV-cache behavior, and causal-mask evidence against the candidate.
Check the reported num_q_heads, num_kv_heads, head_dim, and hidden_size relationship against trusted model facts.
Distinguish component coverage from legal parameter binding; passing semantic coverage does not cure a binding error.
Report evidence-backed semantic gaps or contradictions to the final gate.

subtasks.title: Verify attention expansion and head semantics

handoff_rule.condition: Hand off a disposition only after reconciling all parallel reviews with current checker evidence. Promote only if strict bindings are legal, required coverage is supported, and cross-layer constraints remain consistent; otherwise retain the blocker and request an approved bounded repair or authoritative input resolution.
downstream_consumers: bounded template-repair authority if approval is required

Changing model facts, numeric policy, board assumptions, or template internals.
primary_responsibilities: Confirm which supplied checker results pass and fail, and map the strict binding failure to the affected constraints.
